Implementation boundaries to double-check
  • Discovery uses the full app inventory. modified_files and modified_components are consumed by the build, not by the generator.
  • Discovery preserves complete marker groups and exact node IDs. Runner labels derive from pytest requirements plus infrastructure policy. Build metadata still excludes unbuilt app directories before the worker selects its group.
  • The manifest consistency check is separate. It runs once on espressif/idf:latest, outside the per-version pipelines.
  • Missing artifacts, failed jobs and cancellations are not simulated here. The map shows wiring and eligibility, not a real workflow run.
  • CI-only changes skip the version pipelines unless the caller has the PR: test all apps label. Unit tests and the consistency check still run.
